_comment: Cases for scripts/test-composition-architecture.py. `compositions` are krateo-057 objects (2026-09-26,
read-only): the composition and its managed objects, managedFields dropped and the objects' spec
dropped (no program reads it). The architecture ConfigMap is not a fixture: the runner renders
helm/builder-publish for the composition, as CDC does, so the chart's own output feeds the RESTAction.
A case may patch the composition's `spec` (an RFC 7386 merge patch) and list objects its chart has not
rendered for those values (`unmanaged`, dropped from status.managed) before the ConfigMap is rendered.
Each case mutates that cluster the way a real caller meets it; `proves` says what it pins.
A `deny` is recorded `as` snowplow records it: `dispatch` is internal dispatch's Forbidden string (in
cluster, snowplow with #256), `httpcall` is plumbing's response.Status (the httpcall fall-through, out
of cluster). snowplow 1.12.13 serves a denied GET under its ServiceAccount, so no deny case holds there.

cases.name: demo
cases.proves: A finished composition, with the ConfigMap and every other managed object served from snowplow's informer (no apiVersion, no kind): S4 change-request-open, all ready, joined by name, and no step active.

cases.name: v1b
cases.proves: The live v1b: S2 seeding, waiting on the Repo, which is NotSynced (ReconcileError); the files and the PR are withheld, and not fetched.

cases.name: v1b-cdc-extras
cases.proves: CDC's extras (compositionName, compositionNamespace, compositionId) read exactly as the page's.

cases.name: v1b-denied-repository
cases.proves: A caller denied the Repository, in cluster with #256 (internal dispatch's Forbidden string): the rendered Repo proves the Repository was ready at the last render, so it is done, inferred, and says it is not readable.

cases.name: v1b-denied-current
cases.proves: A caller denied the current node, as plumbing's response.Status (snowplow's httpcall path, out of cluster; no `details`): the Repo is unreadable, named from the message, and the level is still known.

cases.name: v1b-current-deleted
cases.proves: The current node is gone (404) though status.managed still lists it: it is waiting, not unreadable.

cases.name: v1b-current-dropped
cases.proves: The current node was served with no error and nothing in it (an informer drop): unavailable, 'could not be read'.

cases.name: v1b-current-failed
cases.proves: The current node's read never got an answer (a 500 with no object name in it): unavailable, never 'not readable with your access'.

cases.name: demo-denied-two-files
cases.proves: Two of ten files denied (as httpcall's response.Status): the rendered PullRequest proves all ten were ready, so the files are done, inferred, the composition is still all ready, and the node counts the denied files.

cases.name: demo-denied-all-files
cases.proves: All ten files denied, in cluster with #256: the rendered PullRequest still proves them ready, and a node denied in full keeps the plain 'not readable with your access'.

cases.name: composition-forbidden
cases.proves: The composition itself is denied (as httpcall's response.Status): readable is false, every present node is unknown, no object is fetched, and the body names the composition, not its ConfigMaps.

cases.name: composition-failed
cases.proves: The composition's read never got an answer (a 500): readable false, access error, and the body says only that it could not be read.

cases.name: composition-version-moved
cases.proves: The composition's CRD now serves a newer version and the ConfigMap still names the old one until CDC renders it again: the read is a 404, access error, and nobody is told their access is the problem.

cases.name: configmap-forbidden
cases.proves: The ConfigMap is denied as plumbing's response.Status (snowplow's httpcall path, out of cluster): no architecture, access forbidden, and the body says it is not readable.

cases.name: configmap-denied-by-snowplow
cases.proves: The ConfigMap is denied in cluster with #256 (internal dispatch's Forbidden string): access forbidden, and the body says it is not readable.

cases.name: configmap-failed
cases.proves: The ConfigMap's read never got an answer (a 500): no architecture, access error, and the body says only that it could not be read.

cases.name: no-configmap
cases.proves: No ConfigMap (404) though status.managed lists it: no architecture, no claim about access, and the body says only that it could not be read.

cases.name: label-mismatch
cases.proves: A ConfigMap of that name that another composition rendered is not this composition's architecture, and not a denial.

cases.name: configmap-no-graph
cases.proves: The ConfigMap has no graph (the frontend <= 1.6.59 composer wrote <release>-architecture without one): no architecture, and not a denial.

cases.name: graph-v2
cases.proves: A graph shape this portal does not know (a later composer's v: 2): no architecture, and an administrator is not told their access is the problem.

cases.name: no-extras
cases.proves: No extras: no architecture (the call goes to a name that cannot exist), and not a denial.

cases.name: empty-descriptor
cases.proves: A chart that declares no resources: nodes [], all ready, level null, and one sentence instead of an empty card.

cases.name: demo-no-pull-request
cases.proves: pullRequest.create=false (stop at the pushed branch): the PullRequest is absent, the composition is all ready at S3 committing, and the strip draws S1-S3 only, never a change request that does not exist.

cases.name: v1b-no-source
cases.proves: No source to seed from: the Repo is absent, so the strip draws S1, S3, S4, keeps each level's own number, and `current` points at S3 among the steps drawn.

gate.name: v1b-rendered
gate.proves: Once the chart renders its ConfigMap, status.managed lists it and the card shows.

gate.name: v1b-today
gate.proves: Before the chart ships architecture.yaml (057 today): nothing renders, composition-architecture is never called.

gate.name: no-architecture
gate.proves: A composition that manages ConfigMaps, none of them its architecture: nothing renders.

gate.name: not-found
gate.proves: composition-detail cannot resolve the composition for this caller: nothing renders, like the rest of the page.
